nodes.label: Horizontal light logo: white bee-planet mark and Honebill wordmark
nodes.rationale: Solid black field. On the left, a white bee-planet mark: two antennae, a ring around a rounded body, a four-point sparkle at the center, and a two-lobed lower body. On the right, a white geometric wordmark reads Honebill.

nodes.label: Honebill
